units.rawText: A red-hot meteor blasts past. Thurbel catches a flash of that glorious hue, an understanding smile appearing on her face.
units.displayText: A red-hot meteor blasts past. Thurbel catches a flash of that glorious hue, an understanding smile appearing on her face.

spans.text: A red-hot meteor blasts past. Thurbel catches a flash of that glorious hue, an understanding smile appearing on her face.

units.rawText: Of course, it was never meant to be...
units.displayText: Of course, it was never meant to be...

spans.text: Of course, it was never meant to be...

units.rawText: As Bonneville crosses the line, the veil of silence over the arena is shattered by ovation and cheer.
units.displayText: As Bonneville crosses the line, the veil of silence over the arena is shattered by ovation and cheer.

spans.text: As Bonneville crosses the line, the veil of silence over the arena is shattered by ovation and cheer.

units.rawText: She had become a four-time champion of N-WSBK, a legend whose name is spoken by generations after.
units.displayText: She had become a four-time champion of N-WSBK, a legend whose name is spoken by generations after.

spans.text: She had become a four-time champion of N-WSBK, a legend whose name is spoken by generations after.

units.rawText: This would be the last time Bonneville and Thurbel spoke. In the dusky arena passage Thurbel encounters Bonneville, applauding her with a smile.
units.displayText: This would be the last time Bonneville and Thurbel spoke. In the dusky arena passage Thurbel encounters Bonneville, applauding her with a smile.

spans.text: This would be the last time Bonneville and Thurbel spoke. In the dusky arena passage Thurbel encounters Bonneville, applauding her with a smile.

units.rawText: Congrats, three-time champion. No, four-time now.
units.displayText: Congrats, three-time champion. No, four-time now.

spans.text: Congrats, three-time champion. No, four-time now.

units.rawText: You won fair and square. You deserve the spoils.
units.displayText: You won fair and square. You deserve the spoils.

spans.text: You won fair and square. You deserve the spoils.

units.rawText: I don't care much for a title, but I'd rather not lose to those sick tactics.
units.displayText: I don't care much for a title, but I'd rather not lose to those sick tactics.

spans.text: I don't care much for a title, but I'd rather not lose to those sick tactics.

units.rawText: You won't be seeing me on the track anymore. Thinking about it, I'm more than happy to finally leave behind the "always second" curse.
units.displayText: You won't be seeing me on the track anymore. Thinking about it, I'm more than happy to finally leave behind the "always second" curse.

spans.text: You won't be seeing me on the track anymore. Thinking about it, I'm more than happy to finally leave behind the "always second" curse.

units.rawText: What you were talking about before... that no future stuff. Never got a clear answer from you, you retiring?
units.displayText: What you were talking about before... that no future stuff. Never got a clear answer from you, you retiring?

spans.text: What you were talking about before... that no future stuff. Never got a clear answer from you, you retiring?

units.rawText: There is no such thing as retirement for IA's drivers. Those no longer of use are scrapped, their core data and parts used for a new Doll.
units.displayText: There is no such thing as retirement for IA's drivers. Those no longer of use are scrapped, their core data and parts used for a new Doll.

spans.text: There is no such thing as retirement for IA's drivers. Those no longer of use are scrapped, their core data and parts used for a new Doll.

units.rawText: The only way for me to escape that fate was to win this match. Unfortunately, I wasn't good enough.
units.displayText: The only way for me to escape that fate was to win this match. Unfortunately, I wasn't good enough.

spans.text: The only way for me to escape that fate was to win this match. Unfortunately, I wasn't good enough.

units.rawText: That's nuts! They've gone crazy! What the hell are they thinking?
units.displayText: That's nuts! They've gone crazy! What the hell are they thinking?

spans.text: That's nuts! They've gone crazy! What the hell are they thinking?

units.rawText: Something is only as valuable as it is useful. Couldn't be a more common attitude for humans towards Dolls. I can't say I'm going out without regrets, not a single first place finish in my career...
units.displayText: Something is only as valuable as it is useful. Couldn't be a more common attitude for humans towards Dolls. I can't say I'm going out without regrets, not a single first place finish in my career...

spans.text: Something is only as valuable as it is useful. Couldn't be a more common attitude for humans towards Dolls. I can't say I'm going out without regrets, not a single first place finish in my career...

units.rawText: But each and every time I followed the rules, competed fairly, and gave it everything I had. I suppose that soothes the wounds a bit.
units.displayText: But each and every time I followed the rules, competed fairly, and gave it everything I had. I suppose that soothes the wounds a bit.

spans.text: But each and every time I followed the rules, competed fairly, and gave it everything I had. I suppose that soothes the wounds a bit.

units.rawText: Thank you, Bonneville. At least there'll be no stains on my career record, thanks to you. To think that I begged sympathy from you back then... how embarrassing.
units.displayText: Thank you, Bonneville. At least there'll be no stains on my career record, thanks to you. To think that I begged sympathy from you back then... how embarrassing.

spans.text: Thank you, Bonneville. At least there'll be no stains on my career record, thanks to you. To think that I begged sympathy from you back then... how embarrassing.

units.rawText: ...If you told me what was really up, I wouldn't have done what I did.
units.displayText: ...If you told me what was really up, I wouldn't have done what I did.

spans.text: ...If you told me what was really up, I wouldn't have done what I did.

units.rawText: That'd make me hold you in contempt if it went down that way.
units.displayText: That'd make me hold you in contempt if it went down that way.

spans.text: That'd make me hold you in contempt if it went down that way.

units.rawText: You say that, but I'm the executioner here, knowing or not. I've just cut off your last chance at life.
units.displayText: You say that, but I'm the executioner here, knowing or not. I've just cut off your last chance at life.

spans.text: You say that, but I'm the executioner here, knowing or not. I've just cut off your last chance at life.

units.rawText: I never cared much for the title. I never thought that so many people... needed, cared about it. If that's how it is then why do I...
units.displayText: I never cared much for the title. I never thought that so many people... needed, cared about it. If that's how it is then why do I...

spans.text: I never cared much for the title. I never thought that so many people... needed, cared about it. If that's how it is then why do I...

units.rawText: Hah, a champion ought to sit on their throne. Better grow some eyes in the back of your head, though.
units.displayText: Hah, a champion ought to sit on their throne. Better grow some eyes in the back of your head, though.

spans.text: Hah, a champion ought to sit on their throne. Better grow some eyes in the back of your head, though.

units.rawText: The M conglomerate behind IA's already got their eyes on you. They won't let something stay between them and their source of money for long.
units.displayText: The M conglomerate behind IA's already got their eyes on you. They won't let something stay between them and their source of money for long.

spans.text: The M conglomerate behind IA's already got their eyes on you. They won't let something stay between them and their source of money for long.

units.rawText: ...Let them do their worst.
units.displayText: ...Let them do their worst.

spans.text: ...Let them do their worst.

units.rawText: A biker gang's more direct methods is just child's play to those people in the high castle. Be careful in everything that you do. This is about as much as I can do for you.
units.displayText: A biker gang's more direct methods is just child's play to those people in the high castle. Be careful in everything that you do. This is about as much as I can do for you.

spans.text: A biker gang's more direct methods is just child's play to those people in the high castle. Be careful in everything that you do. This is about as much as I can do for you.

units.rawText: You're a crimson shooting star, and you ought to chase after speed as you desire. It's every racer's first wish, after all, and I pray that you keep that virtue in your heart.
units.displayText: You're a crimson shooting star, and you ought to chase after speed as you desire. It's every racer's first wish, after all, and I pray that you keep that virtue in your heart.

spans.text: You're a crimson shooting star, and you ought to chase after speed as you desire. It's every racer's first wish, after all, and I pray that you keep that virtue in your heart.

units.rawText: It's just that... I may never see it. Best of luck, cowboy.
units.displayText: It's just that... I may never see it. Best of luck, cowboy.

spans.text: It's just that... I may never see it. Best of luck, cowboy.

units.rawText: Thurbel pats Bonneville's shoulder as she always does, walking against the light, walking towards her inexorable fate.
units.displayText: Thurbel pats Bonneville's shoulder as she always does, walking against the light, walking towards her inexorable fate.

spans.text: Thurbel pats Bonneville's shoulder as she always does, walking against the light, walking towards her inexorable fate.

units.rawText: That day, the track lost a driver named Thurbel. Gradually, the name fades from common memory, with only the occasional mention of her moniker, "eternally second".
units.displayText: That day, the track lost a driver named Thurbel. Gradually, the name fades from common memory, with only the occasional mention of her moniker, "eternally second".

spans.text: That day, the track lost a driver named Thurbel. Gradually, the name fades from common memory, with only the occasional mention of her moniker, "eternally second".

units.rawText: Only Bonneville knows that she played the role of the executioner. In the name of the champion, she slew a worthy opponent.
units.displayText: Only Bonneville knows that she played the role of the executioner. In the name of the champion, she slew a worthy opponent.

spans.text: Only Bonneville knows that she played the role of the executioner. In the name of the champion, she slew a worthy opponent.

units.rawText: After another event in June of the same year, Bonneville left her team. She never stepped foot into competition again.
units.displayText: After another event in June of the same year, Bonneville left her team. She never stepped foot into competition again.

spans.text: After another event in June of the same year, Bonneville left her team. She never stepped foot into competition again.
